hero.title: Ukwethenjwa okungekho sizwe
hero.subtitle: I-Genesis Mesh iyingqalasizinda yokwethembana ephathekayo yezinhlelo ezizimele ngaphansi kombuso kazwelonke: ubunikazi be-cryptographic, izivumelwano zokuqashelana, kanye negunya elingahoxiswa, okusebenza ngendlela efanayo emazweni angu-190 asafuna ukuzimela ngokwedijithali nakulawo mandla amathathu asevele enakho.

stakes.label: Okusengcupheni
stakes.title: Ukuzimela ngokwedijithali manje sekuyindaba yokusinda kwesizwe, futhi alukho ungqimba lwezivumelwano lwemishini.
stakes.subtitle: Amazwe asayina izivumelwano. Izinhlelo zedijithali azinalutho olulingana nalokho. Lapho i-ejenti ye-AI yesizwe esisodwa ihlangana nengqalasizinda yesinye, umbuzo othi ubani ofakazela leli bhizinisi, lisebenza ngaphansi kwemithetho kabani, futhi ingabe lokho kwethembana kungahoxiswa, ungumbuzo wezobudlelwano bamazwe ongakabi nayo impendulo yephrothokholi namuhla. I-Genesis Mesh iyileyo mpendulo.
stakes.notLine: Akuyona i-blockchain. Akuyona i-VPN. Akuyona i-service mesh. Akulona uhlaka lwama-ejenti. Akuyona indawo yokuhweba. Iwungqimba lwezivumelwano lwemishini.

stats.twoDesc: Amandla asevele ephethe sonke isitaki sawo
stats.threeDesc: Iphrothokholi esebenzela womabili, ngaphandle kokukhetha uhlangothi

powers.label: Amandla Amathathu
powers.title: Amandla azimele awadingi inkululeko. Adinga ukusebenzisana ngaphandle kokuzithoba.
powers.subtitle: Inani liyaguquka, kodwa alinyamalali. Ayikho inhlokodolobha yezwe elingumfelandawonye eyamukela umsuka wokwethembana welinye, ngakho ukuqashelana kufanele kudluliswe njengezivumelwano ezisayiniwe, ezinomkhawulo, nezingahoxiswa phakathi kwabalinganayo.

cn.title: Fakazela ngokobuchwepheshe ukuthi akukho kulawula.
cn.desc: Konke ukuthunyelwa kwengqalasizinda kwamanye amazwe kubhekana nokuphikiswa okufanayo: imishini yenu isho ukulawula kwenu. Ukwethembana okuqinisekisekayo, okuphethwe umqhubi, nokungahoxiswa kuyimpendulo yobuchwepheshe kulokho kuphikiswa kwezepolitiki.
benefits: Amazwe angabambisene ayacwaninga futhi ahoxise ngaphandle kokwethemba izwi lomuntu
Ukuqashelana namazwe aseNtshonalanga azimele, alukho uhlangothi oluphethe okhiye bolunye
Ukuhlanganiswa kweShayina neNtshonalanga ngaphansi kwemodeli eyodwa yokubusa

us.title: Abalingani ngeke bamukele umsuka wakho wokwethembana.
us.desc: Abalingani be-Five Eyes, NATO, ne-EU: akekho kubo oyozithoba ku-trust anchor elawulwa yi-US. Izivumelwano zokuqashelana zivumela umlingani ngamunye ukuba aqhubeke ezimele kuyilapho ukwethembana kusadluliselwa.
benefits: Ama-hyperscaler athengisa ngaphansi kwemithetho yamazwe angaphandle yokuzimela

kp.title: Isivivinyo sezwe elizimele nelingathembi muntu.
kp.desc: Izwe elingathembi lutho lwangaphandle. Uma iphrothokholi isebenzela izwe elizimele neliqaphe kakhulu emhlabeni, lingenakho ukuncika futhi umqhubi engumnikazi ogcwele, isebenzela noma ubani.

mechanics.label: Indlela Yokusebenza
mechanics.title: Ingqalasizinda engafaki mapolitiki, efaka kuphela indlela yokusebenza.
mechanics.subtitle: Ingqalasizinda eminingi yokwethembana ifaka ezombusazwe zalowo ophethe umsuka. I-Genesis Mesh ifaka imisebenzi emine kuphela bese ishiya ezombusazwe emazweni azimele. Yilokho okuyenza ibe sezingeni lezivumelwano kunokuba ibe sezingeni lomhlinzeki.

ops.name: Qinisekisa
ops.desc: Ubufakazi be-cryptographic bokuthi ubani ophethe igunya: ubunikazi be-Ed25519, ama-genesis block asayiniwe, namaketanga obufakazi.

ops.name: Khawulela
ops.desc: Ukunikezwa kwamandla okunomkhawulo wobubanzi nesikhathi. Ama-capability manifest achaza lokho ubunikazi ngabunye obungakwenza, hhayi okungaphezu kwalokho.

ops.name: Hoxisa
ops.desc: Lapho nje ukwethembana kuphuka, ukuhoxisa okusayiniwe kusabalala kweqe imingcele yamazwe azimele, futhi kuyahlonishwa.

ops.name: Cwaninga
ops.desc: Zonke izinqumo zishiya ubufakazi obubonisa uma buphazanyisiwe. Akudingeki muntu avele akholwe izwi lakho.

protocol.label: Iphrothokholi
protocol.title: Uhlelo oluvulekile lwe-RFC, olwakheke njengamazinga, hhayi njengomkhiqizo womhlinzeki.
protocol.subtitle: Sekukhishwe izizukulwane ezintathu zama-SDK (TypeScript, Go, .NET). Izivivinyo ezingu-1,041. Ama-lemma ayisishiyagalombili e-Tamarin ahlolwe ngomshini. Amazwe azimele asebenzisa amafu amaningi asebenza bukhoma ku-Azure, DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, naku-Akamai/Linode.

l1.name: Umnyombo Wephrothokholi
l1.desc: Ubunikazi be-Ed25519, ama-genesis block asayiniwe, ukubhalisa, ukuhoxisa, ukuqondisa, nokucwaninga.

l2.name: Imiphakathi Ezimele
l2.desc: Izizinda zokwethembana ezizimele. Ngasinye silawula ubulungu, ukubusa, nokuhoxisa kwaso.

l3.name: Inethiwekhi Yokuqashelana
l3.desc: Izivumelwano phakathi kwamazwe azimele. Izindlela zokwethembana nokusabalaliswa kokuhoxisa kweqa imingcele.

live.title: Bukhoma - Uxhaxha Lwamazwe Azimele Olusetshenziswa Abanakekeli
live.subtitle: Amafu Amaningi / Okhiye Abazimele / Inqubomgomo Ezimele

silicon.label: Isilikhoni
silicon.title: Iphrothokholi ezimele esebenza kusilikhoni sangaphandle ingumbukiso nje.
silicon.subtitle: I-Genesis Mesh iqinisekisa igunya kusofthiwe. Kodwa isofthiwe izimele kuphela ngezinga isilikhoni esebenza kuso esizimele ngalo. I-TSWI, i-Tunisian Sovereign Wafer Initiative, ivala umjikelezo: impahla yengqondo ye-interposer ephethwe, indawo yokupakisha ephethwe, nesitaki sokuhlela esiphethwe. Kungena ama-chiplet ajwayelekile; kuphuma amandla okucubungula azimele ngaphansi kombuso kazwelonke. Inikwa amandla elanga ezimpambanweni zamazwekazi amathathu, futhi isusa ngaphezu kwengxenye yezindleko zokucubungula. Isigaba sokuqala sesiqediwe.
silicon.conclusion: Iphrothokholi ibusa umqondo wokusebenza. ITunisia ibusa isilikhoni.

live.label: Bukhoma
live.title: Akusona isithembiso. Uhlelo olusebenzayo.
live.subtitle: Imodeli eyodwa yegunya, esebenza ekukhiqizeni. Akulona uhlelo lokuhlola, futhi akusona isakhiwo sokubhekisela.

closing.title: Thola igunya libe ngelakho.
closing.subtitle: Kulawo angu-190, kuyindlela emfushane kakhulu yokuba ngabanikazi bama-trust anchor awo. Kulawo mandla amathathu, kuwukuphela kwendlela yokusebenzisana ngaphandle kokuwadela.

builders.title: Sungula isizinda sakho sokwethembana esizimele.
builders.desc: Funda ama-RFC, landa ama-SDK e-TypeScript / Go / .NET, bese usungula i-L2 Sovereign Community engqalasizindeni osuvele ungumnikazi wayo.

strategic.title: Le ngxoxo ayiqali nge-SDK.
strategic.desc: Funda indaba ephelele ye-Elections 2026 ukuze uthole isisekelo sefilosofi, bese uvula umzila oqondile, wangasese noyimfihlo. Awekho amafomu, awekho amafaneli, futhi abekho abalamuli.

footer.signature: Ama-build ale sayithi asayinwa ngaphansi kwegunya le-Genesis Mesh.

seo.description: Indwangu ezimele yokwethembana, yobunikazi neyokuxhumana yezinhlelo ezizenzelayo. Ayichemi ekuzimeleni futhi isezingeni lezivumelwano: qinisekisa, khawulela, hoxisa, cwaninga. Akuyona i-blockchain. Akuyona i-VPN. Akuyona i-service mesh.
